pictures.name: CLW1-Night-Well
pictures.prompt: Night in a walled garden outside ancient Athens, rows of vegetables and fig trees under the moon. Cleanthes, a big broad-shouldered man of about thirty with a boxer’s flattened nose, short curly brown hair and a short beard, in a rough brown tunic, hauls a heavy wooden bucket up from a stone well on a rope, muscles straining, water splashing silver. Deep blue moonlight, a small lamp glowing on the well’s edge. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
